item: Sink sweep 4/4: the remaining exc_info and .exception log calls go through the scrub
summary: The last ~100 files with a raw exception log call (database, backup, ingest, analytics, llm, safety, monitoring and the small directories) use secret_scrub.log_failure; the exc_info allowlist now holds only src/database/repair.py (owner wal). Stored records that carry engine words (str(exc) into a dict) are NOT in this PR: counted at 920 sites in 203 files and queued as the next slice.
